champion.tips: MALZAHAR TIPS AND TRICKS During the later stages of the game, you will need to stick with your team at all costs. Malz is very immobile and vulnerable- so you cannot split push or stay in a side lane alone. When sieging objectives like Baron, a tower or the Dragon. Stand towards the front of your team and threaten an engage with your R . Ulting a key target will allow your team to quickly pick someone off or take the objective for free. Avoid team fighting unless your R is up. Malzahar is a weak team fighter without his R , so do not fight without it!
champion.builds: THE BEST MALZAHAR BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Malzahar Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, as well as Cosmic Insight and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blackfire Torch as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Liandry's Torment. For your last 3 items, you should build Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Rabadon's Deathcap and finish with Zhonya's Hourglass. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 52.5% winrate over 750 matches played. Optional Your second option for Malzahar Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Blackfire Torch, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Liandry's Torment as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. The skill order for this build is E - Q - W. In the current patch, this build has a 46.0% win rate over 487 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Coup de Grace with Presence of Mind in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blackfire Torch as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Rylai's Crystal Scepter as a third item. You want to finish the build with Liandry's Torment, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 56.5% win rate across 347 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Malzahar Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Arcane Comet, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm as your primary rune tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Malignance as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Liandry's Torment as third item. The last 3 options are Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Rabadon's Deathcap and Morellonomicon. The ability order for this build is E - Q - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 56.1% win rate over 139 matches played. Situational Malzahar Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Malzahar build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Malzahar runes page.
